Since w has the highest value ($77) and I have the highest priority at w, I should rank it first.
Next, y has a value of $65 and I have the highest priority at y, so I should rank it second.
x has a value of $59 and z has a value of $49. I have priority 2 at both. Since x has a higher value, I should rank it third.
Finally, z has the lowest value and I have priority 2, so I should rank it last.

Therefore, my ranking should be w > y > x > z.
